My first attempt at a piece of furniture: a small oak coffee table with a single shelf.
It's a stretch, but everything on the [roadmap](../roadmap.qmd) is pointing here.

## Time spent so far

I've been logging hours per session to see where the time actually goes. The Python below
runs at render time and its output is frozen into `_freeze/` — so the GitHub Actions
runner never re-executes it.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

sessions = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "task": ["Design", "Milling", "Joinery", "Glue-up", "Finishing"],
        "hours": [3, 5, 8, 2, 4],
    }
)

ax = sessions.plot.bar(x="task", y="hours", legend=False, color="#2b7cff", rot=0)
ax.set_ylabel("hours")
ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.set_title("Coffee table — hours by task")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

Joinery is eating the schedule, which tracks — it's the part I'm least practised at.

## Status

Still in progress. The base is glued up; next is fitting the shelf and starting the
finish.
